name: Tool — MCP with project Entra identity
summary: MCPTool with authType='AgenticIdentity' (project identity) on a BYOM-routed agent.
description: An MCP tool with project managed identity authenticates to an MCP server using the Foundry project's identity while the Prompt Agent's orchestrator model is BYOM-routed. This supports gateway-backed agents calling enterprise MCP tools without per-agent credentials.
notes:
Not yet confirmed against Foundry for project managed-identity MCP auth. Docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/foundry/agents/how-to/mcp-authentication. See `test.py` for the `MCP_SERVER_URL` probe.

MCP is on the official BYOM-supported tools list, but this identity mode still needs a live server configured in the canary environment.
